definition.prompt: Create a square editorial collage with exactly six separate vignettes, using tactile paper-cut shapes and soft shadows on warm cream paper. Arrange: an iced coffee in a plain glass, a paperback with an unlettered cover, over-ear headphones, comfortable sneakers, a canvas tote, and a sleepy cat curled on a cushion. Treat the cat and cushion as one vignette. Use forest-green and orange accents with generous negative space. Add only the title "WEEKEND STARTER PACK" and the large footer "Coffee. Books. No plans." Render both exactly once. No brand logos, additional objects or extra labels.

review.notes: Six distinct paper-cut groups: iced coffee, unlettered book, headphones, pair of sneakers, tote, cat on cushion. Forest-green and orange palette, tactile paper and soft shadows. Title WEEKEND STARTER PACK and footer Coffee. Books. No plans. appear once each with correct punctuation; no brand logos or extra labels.
